tagline.en_US: A self-hosted automation platform whose agents can watch websites and services, transform events, and trigger actions. Uses Huginn’s all-in-one image.

description.en_US: Huginn is a system for building automated agents that perform online tasks. Agents read the web, watch for events, and take actions by creating and consuming data along a directed graph. It allows users to automate complex workflows and monitor services while keeping complete ownership of their data.
